messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had wanted to run home and shower, scrub the ick off my skin until I couldn't feel anything at all.

output.original_text: I had wanted to run home and shower, scrub the ick off my skin until I couldn't feel anything at all.
output.joy: I couldn't wait to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until I felt utterly refreshed!
output.sadness: I just wanted to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until I felt numb and empty inside.
output.fear: I felt a sudden urge to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until I was sure I could erase my anxiety completely.
output.anger: I was so frustrated that I just had to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until it wouldn't cling to me anymore.
output.surprise: I surprisingly felt the strong urge to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until I couldn't feel anything at all!
output.disgust: I was repulsed and just wanted to run home and shower, scrubbing the ick off my skin until it was completely gone.
